text:
maya: quick alert from zircon-v0.2 (int8) onboarding smoke: mixed CJK/RTL detok oddities. ran multilingual-eval-suite and saw consistent spacing before ideographic punctuation and occasional mirrored parens in Arabic/Hebrew samples.

maya: numbers: zh chrF -3.4, ja BLEU -1.7, ar paren-mirror +10%. eval: https://rwd.internal/evals/1755004321 :mag:

teo: can you paste a tiny fp16 -> int8 repro and tokenizer peek? suspect embedding-shard rotation or remap table bug during shard-merge.

maya: repro snippets: 
```
src: 我喜欢吃苹果。
fp16: I like eating apples.
int8: I like eating apples .   <-- extra space before ideographic full stop
```
```
src: (هذا) كتاب
fp16: (this) book
int8: ) this ) book   <-- mirrored/duplicated parens
```

rachel: tokenizer dump shows tokens identical pre/post, but embedding id window around punctuation shifted by -1 after shard-merge. example: '3002' token id moved 1007->1006.

hyun: hypothesis: shard-merge routine applies a rotation to compact embeddings but writes the remap table after writing the packed table; low-index tokens collide with punctuation IDs during transient.

teo: can you rerun with shard-merge disabled: `rwd evaluate --model zircon-v0.2 --quant=int8 --no-shard-merge --dataset multilingual-eval-suite`

maya: ran it. results: zh chrF drop reduced to -0.9, ja BLEU -0.4, ar paren-mirror gone on 97% samples. so shard-merge implicated.

build-bot: build: zircon-v0.2-int8 image built (sha: 9f3a7b...) :package: 1755005200

rachel: can you attach small vocab diff? grep around ideographic punctuation and paren chars.

maya: `vocab_before['。']=id_1007`, `vocab_after['。']=id_1006` (one-off). paren '(' moved id_450->id_449 after merge.

hyun: filing ML-2601 "zircon: shard-merge compaction causes token id rotation on quant builds" assigned to @hyun + @teo. https://rwd.internal/issue/ML-2601

teo: plan: make shard-merge deterministic and emit remap file atomically (write remap then swap). add unit test: run compaction 20x assert token->id equality. add canary to block promotion on id drift for punctuation/brackets.

maya: added failing promptset and small bisect: `./scripts/bisect_shard_merge.sh --model zircon-v0.2 --steps 25`.

rachel: also recommend adding token-diff to eval UI with visual highlight for one-off id moves on punctuation/paren/number tokens. filing follow-up ML-2602.

hyun: patch incoming, will open PR today.

maya: thanks everyone, ping this thread with any other mixed-orient failures. :white_check_mark:
